OwnControllerDraftValue.from_relh: Explicit legal mask and public ally/enemy composition, timestamp-clean labels, fixed-point export.
OwnControllerDraftValue.operation: Estimate returns for our controller by legal class and draft context; compare with our carry-first baseline on separate future rounds. Do not call imitation agreement predicted XP.
OwnControllerDraftValue.negative_case: If all available choices are weak melee, no draft model can select an absent carry; focus on the melee controller.

MeleeIncomeAndReach.from_relh: Persistent active engagement and class-conditioned controller; high mage hero-XP contribution is supporting observation, not melee causal evidence.
MeleeIncomeAndReach.operation: Practice melee target approach, ability-specific legal reach and healing behind allied creeps as a bundle. Pursue a hero only when a plausible reachable finish beats immediate creep income; break stalled chases and retain safe XP-sharing range.
MeleeIncomeAndReach.negative_case: Do not inherit relh700squared hero pursuit or300squared tower preference; those transfers lack a passing score result.

ClassKitAndReturn.from_relh: Class-aware gear path plus prompt affordable buyback; exact source observable, causal benefit untested.
ClassKitAndReturn.operation: Test a melee-specific affordable kit and a corresponding readiness threshold for buyback together. Keep gold/time safety, farming recovery and portals. Track time-to-kit, recovered field time and XP gained after return.
ClassKitAndReturn.negative_case: No blind always-buyback or extra-potion policy; relh has higher death count, very little healing and no portals.

proposed_tests.design: IR-first combined melee-only reach/target/lane-presence skills; native practice plus matched full-game current-engine comparison. Class/controller and draft seat must be separated; retain identical carry commands where unaffected.
proposed_tests.falsifier: No improvement in nonzero/productive frequency or lower mean; shorter chases/rejection counts without accepted effects do not pass.

proposed_tests.design: Combined class-kit and buyback-readiness intervention; prospective late-seat controls both colors, carry regression controls, then independent fresh score comparison. Use ablations before attributing benefit to gear versus buyback.
proposed_tests.falsifier: Gold diverted from kit, recurring low-income deaths or more field time with worse XP-minus-time.
